lines.text: Sammy the squirrel collected five hundred crunchy acorns in his secret hollow oak!
Mine, all mine! Sammy cheered, sitting on his giant mountain of nuts!
Outside his tree, the winter wind whistled cold, and tiny birds searched for food!
Sammy ate ten acorns alone in the dark, but his heart felt cold and hollow!
Having all the treasure in the forest is boring when you have zero friends to play with!
Sammy pushed his door open and shouted, Acorn picnic at my tree, everyone!
Rabbits, bluebirds, and mice gathered round, singing cheerful songs together!
Joy multiplies when you share it with open paws and a warm heart!
